messages:
Ana (Finance): Quick postmortem follow-up: ingest lag + dedupe bug caused a delayed-usage cluster that inflated token counts in the ledger. Some customers were invoiced before backfill. Need an owner for: invoice hold, backfill validation, customer comms, legal review, and final credit run.
Sam (Billing Eng): I can own backfill validation and final credit calc. Plan: run reconcile query, stage credits to a holding ledger, run manual spot-checks, then post. Will need a safe flag to prevent auto-post.
Jordan (SRE): I'll take immediate pipeline controls and replay orchestration. Proposal: flip source to readonly, enable replay mode with dedupe keys, and run a dry-run replay against staging. If dry-run looks good, schedule prod replay during low traffic window.
Liz (Customer Ops): I'll draft comms cadence (initial heads-up, verification update, final correction). Want to avoid alarming tone; include expected timeline and next steps. Can legal draft approved wording?
Nina (Legal): happy to review. Send the sample comms and any numbers you plan to share. We'll avoid admission language, keep to "we discovered" and "we are correcting."
Sam (Billing Eng): SQL snippet for initial delta calc: ```sql
-- compute token delta per account from late arrivals
WITH late AS (
  SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as late_tokens
  FROM ingest_events
  WHERE received_at > ledger_max_ts
  AND source_tag = 'partner-bridge'
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT l.account_id, l.late_tokens, coalesce(ledger.tokens_posted,0) as ledger_tokens
FROM late l
LEFT JOIN ledger_totals ledger ON ledger.account_id = l.account_id;
```
Jordan (SRE): ops-bot: create incident 7330 with owners Sam/Jordan/Liz/Nina.
ops-bot: Incident 7330 created. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/7330 Checklist: invoice-hold, staging-replay, backfill-query, legal-review, customer-comm, credit-hold.
Ana (Finance): Inventory asks: (1) Which invoices already posted? (2) Which invoicing schedule (monthly/usage) is affected? Mike from RevOps please hop in.
Liz (Customer Ops): I have a handful of customers flagged in the bootstrapped list. Will share the canonical CSV in 7212/attachments + ticket 7330.
Sam (Billing Eng): For safety: create a "credit-staging" account and tag proposed credits with tx:review-required. I'll add an idempotency key check to the posting job.
Jordan (SRE): containment actions: `kubectl scale deployment ingest-proxy --replicas=0` (temporary), enable replay via `replayctl schedule --window "2026-06-15T23:00Z/2026-06-16T03:00Z" --dedupe-key event_id`. Dry-run logs will be at /var/log/replay/dryrun-7330.log.
Nina (Legal): Reviewed comms draft v0.1. Minor edits: remove projected refund amounts, link to support case instead. I'll upload comments to 7330/docs/comms-v0.1.md.
Ana (Finance): Timelines: set a target of provisional credits queued within 7 business days and final posted corrections within 12 business days, contingent on verification. Is that acceptable?
Sam (Billing Eng): 7/12 business days workable if replay validation completes and spot checks pass. We'll run top-10 account manual review before posting.
Jordan (SRE): Alerting to avoid recurrence: adding metric `ingest_late_rate` and new monitor: if >0.4% of daily tokens for 2h -> auto-pause source + open ticket. Will add to Grafana and PagerDuty.
Liz (Customer Ops): Customer cadence: heads-up within 48h of confirmed affected list, update after validation, final notice when credits posted. I'll coordinate timing with Legal.
Ana (Finance): Please add individual checklist items to incident 7330, set owner and ETA. We'll present a remediation summary to execs after the 48h verification.
Sam (Billing Eng): Added checklist + PR #888 (staged-credit flow) to 7330.
Jordan (SRE): Dry-run scheduled; I'll post results in the ticket and call a short verification sync if anything unexpected shows up.
ops-bot: Incident 7330 status updated: staging-replay completed (dry-run) — review pending.
Ana (Finance): Thanks everyone. We'll meet 09:30 PT tomorrow for a quick gate review before any prod posting. :calendar:
